title: Cancore filler protocol v1 — WebSocket frames
$comment: One $def per frame type, validated by name ($defs/<type>). The schemas encode the SENDER rule (protocol §3.1): lowercase hex, uint64 and wider as canonical decimal strings, uint8/16/32 as JSON integers, gateway times in milliseconds. No object is closed (V-2): receivers ignore unknown fields, takers ignore unknown S→F types, and treat an unknown reason/result/code as OTHER/generic. Every enum is open: anyOf [known values, futureEnumValue]. x-direction: S2F = gateway to filler, F2S = filler to gateway, both = either way (ping, pong, error; <type>S2F is the gateway's copy, <type>F2S the filler's). x-rest-only: the type travels only as a REST body (auth.challenge, auth.response: the login of protocol §3.6), never on the WebSocket. Every frame in both directions carries id, sentAt and fillerId (optional only on a gateway error that refuses a login, POST /v1/filler/auth) and is signed (protocol §3.4): `sig` = the gateway key over GatewayMessage{bodyHash} on S2F, `msgSig` = the filler's message key over FillerMessage{bodyHash} on F2S, bodyHash = keccak256(JCS(frame without that field)). No exceptions: ticket.decline, a declining quote.reconfirm.reply, fill.reported, pong and error from the filler are signed too.

uintDec64.description: uint64 as a decimal string: digits only, no sign, no exponent, no leading zero

repayTo.description: where settle pays the filler, encoded for the SOURCE chain (protocol §3.15): EVM — the address left-padded to 32 bytes (repayToEvm); Canton — keccak256(utf8(partyId)) of the filler's registered party

repayToEvm.description: repayTo for an EVM source: zero top 12 bytes (the router refuses others, InvalidBytes32Address) and not the zero address (ZeroAddress). A receiver that knows the source chain checks repayTo against this

deliveryKey.description: the address that sends fill on the destination (FillTicket.deliveryKey); the zero address for a Canton destination

sig65.description: 65-byte r ‖ s ‖ v of an EOA, low-s, v ∈ {27, 28}; no EIP-1271. The pattern refuses any other length or v and an s with its top bit set; isEoaSignature checks the exact bound s ≤ n/2

timeMs.description: unix milliseconds, gateway clock; the minimum rejects seconds

timeS.description: unix seconds as a decimal string (on-chain and signed times)

messageId.description: unique per fillerId and direction across every session of that fillerId; never reused by its sender within maxMessageAgeMs

order.description: ICancoreRouter.Order, twelve fields, every numeric field a decimal string (the shape of canton-order.json vector.order)

fillerId.description: keccak256(utf8(fillerId)) of the filler the user picked

ticket.description: FillTicket(bytes32 orderHash,bytes32 fillerId,address deliveryKey,bytes32 repayTo,uint32 attempt,uint64 validFrom,uint64 validUntil); fillerId is keccak256(utf8(fillerId)), deliveryKey and repayTo are those of the filler's signed ticket.intent (S-22)

futureEnumValue.description: a value added to an open enum within v1 (V-2); the receiver treats it as OTHER/generic. Every protocol enum is `anyOf: [{enum: known values}, futureEnumValue]`

ticketRefusedReason.description: error.reason with TICKET_REFUSED: the pre-ticket check that failed (S-21); the order is re-drawn, nothing is recorded against the filler

quoteAckStatus.description: verdict at receipt time; the final status is on GET /v1/filler/quotes

sig.description: gateway key over GatewayMessage{bodyHash = keccak256(JCS(frame without sig))}

f2sEnvelope.description: What every filler → filler-gateway message and REST request body carries (protocol §3.4, S-19): the gateway refuses one without it, with another fillerId than the session's, with a stale sentAt or a reused id

fillerId.description: the sender; must be the fillerId the session is authenticated for

msgSig.description: the filler's message key over FillerMessage{bodyHash = keccak256(JCS(message without msgSig))}; the body keeps id, fillerId, sentAt and any inner sig

fillerKeyRegistration.description: Proof of possession of a message key (protocol §3.16): FillerKeyRegistration{fillerId, messageKey, issuedAt} signed by that key — at onboarding, and with the NEW key at a manual key change by Cancore staff, who submit it to the key registry of filler-gateway. Not a frame: there is no key-change message. sig must be an EOA signature (65 bytes, low-s, v ∈ {27, 28}) that recovers to messageKey; an EIP-1271 signature is refused

auth.challenge.description: The login challenge, addressed to the fillerId it was asked for: the 200 body of GET /v1/filler/auth/challenge?fillerId=. Never sent on the WebSocket. The filler checks the gateway sig and that fillerId is its own before it signs FillerAuth{fillerId, nonce, expiresAt}

auth.response.description: The body of POST /v1/filler/auth, answered with {token, expiresAt}. sig = FillerAuth{fillerId, nonce, expiresAt} by the registered message key of fillerId (keyAddress = its address); msgSig by the same key. Never sent on the WebSocket: a WebSocket connection is authenticated by the bearer token offered on the upgrade

protocolVersion.description: the gateway answers UNSUPPORTED_VERSION to anything it does not serve; v1 senders send "1"

nonce.description: the auth.challenge nonce this response answers (optional; senders SHOULD send it), so POST /v1/filler/auth finds the live challenge of this fillerId without trying every one

ping.description: Heartbeat, either way. A receiver checks the copy of its direction: pingS2F (gateway sig) or pingF2S (filler msgSig)

pong.description: Answer to a ping, re = ping.id. A receiver checks the copy of its direction: pongS2F (gateway sig) or pongF2S (filler msgSig)

error.description: Either way. A receiver checks the copy of its direction: errorS2F (the gateway's reply, also the REST error body) or errorF2S (the filler's reply to a gateway frame it cannot handle)

errorS2F.description: Reply to the F→S frame `re`; also the REST error body. fillerId may be absent on a refusal of POST /v1/filler/auth, which is not authenticated yet. reason names the failed pre-ticket check with TICKET_REFUSED. retryAfterMs comes with RATE_LIMITED only

retryAfterMs.description: with RATE_LIMITED: ms (≥ 1) until the rate class of the refused message holds a token again, or until the cooldown of the fillerId ends; the filler sends nothing of that class before it

errorF2S.description: The filler's reply to the S→F frame `re` it cannot handle (malformed, unknown orderHash); informational, it changes no state in filler-gateway. Signed like every filler message

inputAmount.description: the total T the maker deposits (inclusive fee), input base units

quote.description: sig = FillerQuote{keccak256(utf8(requestId)), fillerId, amountOut, validUntil, nonce} by the message key, fillerId the envelope's; counts only if validUntil × 1000 ≥ windowCloseAt + quoteTtlMs

quote.ack.description: For every well-formed, correctly signed quote, late ones included (S-12)

quote.reconfirm.reply.description: An accept carries sig = FillerQuote{keccak256(utf8(requestId)), fillerId, amountOut, validUntil, nonce} by the message key; a decline carries only the envelope msgSig

ticket.intent.description: sig = TicketIntent{orderHash, attempt, validFrom, validUntil, fillerId, deliveryKey, repayTo} by the message key, fillerId the envelope's; orderHash, attempt, validFrom, validUntil equal the offer; the issued ticket carries exactly this deliveryKey and repayTo (S-22), or the gateway answers error TICKET_REFUSED (S-21)

ticket.intent.ack.description: Idempotent: a repeated identical intent gets the identical ack

ticket.issued.description: form discriminates the EVM-destination ticket (FillTicket + ticketSig) from the Canton-destination one (DeliveryOrder, with its repayTo); a form added within v1 (V-2) is checked against the common fields only. The filler checks fillerId, deliveryKey and repayTo against its own ticket.intent before it delivers (T-15)

repayTo.description: the repayTo of the DeliveryOrder, = the filler's signed ticket.intent (S-22); fillerId is the envelope's

ticket.receipt.description: form follows the issued ticket (S-14). EVM form (form absent or "evm"): sig = TicketReceipt{ticketHash, ticketSigHash} by the message key. Canton form: sig = CantonTicketReceipt{orderHash, attempt, deliveryOrderCidHash = keccak256(utf8(deliveryOrderCid)), validUntil} by the message key, deliveryOrderCid and validUntil exactly as in ticket.issued; fillerId and repayTo are not part of it (protocol §3.3, §10 D-O)

deliveryOrderCid.description: the contract id of the DeliveryOrder, exactly as ticket.issued sent it

txRef.description: EVM tx hash or Canton update id

fillProof.description: FillProof as the source router hashes it (FILL_PROOF_TYPES, the twelve variant A fields, protocol §3.3), encoded per protocol §3.1: kind, attempt, setId JSON integers; amountDelivered, filledAt decimal strings; fillerId the on-chain form keccak256(utf8(fillerId))

fillerId.description: keccak256(utf8(fillerId)) of the filler that delivered: this filler's

repayTo.description: the payee of settle, encoded for the source chain: the repayTo of this filler's ticket

attestationEvm.description: One attestor signature for an EVM source: EIP-712 over FillProof in the source-router domain; in the payload's order the signature values are the sigs argument of settle

attestationCanton.description: One attestor signature for a Canton source: the same digest, carried as SwapIntent_SettleWithProof takes it (SigEntry {pubKey, sig}; strip 0x for Daml). signer is the address Daml derives from pubKey

pubKey.description: DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the uncompressed secp256k1 key (88 bytes), as KMS GetPublicKey returns it

signature.description: minimal DER ECDSA signature, low-s, no recovery byte

settle.attestations.description: ≥ threshold attestor signatures over the filler's FillProof (§10 D-N, S-13). Sent once per (orderHash, attempt); GET /v1/filler/attestations/{orderHash} serves the same payload. signatures: at least threshold entries, strictly ascending by signer (not expressible here; settleAttestationsErrors checks it). sourceChainId picks the entry form: eip155 → attestationEvm, canton → attestationCanton

refundAfter.description: from this time settle reverts; the node gets its settle included before it

cantonOp.description: A Canton operation of the filler's own external party on the Cancore participant (protocol §3.19): the backend prepares and submits it, the node signs it with its party key and never talks to a Ledger API. party.allocate creates the party (topology); registry.accept accepts the FillerRegistryEntryProposal of the fillerId; delivery.fill exercises DeliveryOrder_Fill of a Canton ticket issued to the filler; intent.settle exercises SwapIntent_SettleWithProof of a Canton-source order the filler delivered; holdings.transfer moves the party's own holdings to a party it names (TransferFactory_Transfer); preapproval.create gives the party a transfer preapproval with the registry of an instrument admin, so transfers to it complete at once

operationId.description: the handle canton.prepared hands out for canton.submit: opaque, 1..64 printable ASCII, valid until expiresAt

edPublicKey.description: the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key of the filler's Canton party, lowercase hex

edSignature.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature by the party key over the bytes of a leg's hash, lowercase hex

cantonLegTransaction.description: A prepared Canton transaction to sign. MUST before signing (protocol §3.19): the node recomputes `hash` from `preparedTransaction` with the participant's prepared-transaction hashing of `hashingSchemeVersion`, decodes the transaction and checks it against `summary` for the op of the message — template and choice, acting and receiving parties, instrument, amount; on any difference it does not sign. It signs the 32 hash bytes with its party key

preparedTransaction.description: the prepared transaction (base64 protobuf) the hash is over. Never logged

hashingSchemeVersion.description: the participant's prepared-transaction hashing scheme the hash was computed with

cantonLegTopology.description: The onboarding topology of the filler's party, in `party.allocate` only (a topology leg in any other op is refused by the schema). MUST before signing (protocol §3.19): the node recomputes the multihash over `topologyTransactions` and checks that they create the party of `summary.partyId` with the key of `summary.publicKey` as its only signing key, hosted on the Cancore participant; on any difference it does not sign. It signs the 34 multihash bytes with its party key

topologyTransactions.description: the topology transactions (base64 protobuf) the multihash is over, in order

canton.prepare.description: Prepare a Canton operation of the sender's own party (§3.19); answered by canton.prepared (re = this id) or error. params select the operation only: the backend picks every contract itself (holdings, delivery order, intent, registry entry, disclosed contracts, attestor signatures). Admission: party.allocate — the fillerId has no party yet, or this key's party; registry.accept — a proposal for the fillerId and its party is live; delivery.fill — an ISSUED Canton ticket of this filler for (orderHash, attempt), before validUntil; intent.settle — a Canton-source order this filler delivered, with attestations held; holdings.transfer — enough unlocked holdings of the asset beyond what the party's open delivery orders need, to a party other than its own; preapproval.create — a registry admin Cancore serves and no live preapproval of the party with it. Each prepare prepares afresh and replaces the filler's open operation of the same op and target

toParty.description: the receiving Canton party; never the filler's own

admin.description: the instrument admin whose registry the preapproval is with

canton.prepared.description: A prepared operation. The node MUST verify every leg before it signs it (cantonLegTransaction, cantonLegTopology): what it signs is what Cancore assembled, and summary is only what Cancore says about it — a leg that does not match summary, or summary that does not match what the node expects of the op, is not signed. Topology legs come with party.allocate only; every other op prepares transactions. Then the node signs every leg's hash with its party key and sends canton.submit before expiresAt. An operationId stays valid until its own expiresAt whatever is prepared after it

hosting.description: how the topology hosts the party: on the Cancore participant alone, with Confirmation permission, threshold 1 — the node checks the decoded topology against it

recipient.description: the Canton party the order delivers to

inputHoldingCids.description: the party's holdings the transfer spends; whatever they hold beyond amount comes back as change

executeBefore.description: the transfer's executeBefore: the order's fillDeadline

transferFactoryCid.description: the registry factory the order pins

amount.description: what the settlement pays the payee: giveAmount less fee.amount, Daml Decimal

payee.description: the party paid: the filler's own

fee.description: the settlement's fee leg; amount 0 when there is none

inputHoldingCids.description: the party's holdings the transfer spends; what they hold beyond amount comes back as change

party.description: the receiver: the filler's own party

admin.description: the registry's instrument admin, as asked

instrumentAllowances.description: instrument ids it is limited to; empty: every instrument of the admin

executeBefore.description: unix s: the preapproval expires then

canton.submit.description: Submit a prepared operation: one party-key signature per leg. Idempotent per operationId: a repeat (after a lost answer or CANTON_UNAVAILABLE) is answered with the same canton.submitted and never executes twice. OPERATION_EXPIRED: prepare again

canton.submitted.description: The operation committed. updateId is its Canton update (absent for party.allocate, a topology change); result names what it created, by op

outcome.description: COMPLETED: the receiver holds it (a preapproval accepted it); PENDING: a TransferInstruction waits for the receiver to accept

routeRef.description: A route of the catalogue (GET /v1/intents/routes): CAIP-2 source and destination

routes.set.description: The routes the filler serves from now on (protocol §3.20): the body of POST /v1/filler/routes. The full list: a route Cancore approved for the filler and not listed here is switched off, a listed one switched on. Every listed route must be approved for the filler (filler_routes enabled by staff), else the whole request is refused ROUTE_NOT_APPROVED and nothing changes. An empty list switches every route off

routes.state.description: Every route Cancore approved for the filler and whether the filler serves it now (active): the 200 body of GET and POST /v1/filler/routes. The filler is asked for quotes on a route only while it is approved and active
